name: linkedin-mcp-server
description: MCP server that gives Claude access to LinkedIn profiles, companies, job details, and people search through your own account
long_description:
# MCP Server for LinkedIn

> Independent open-source project. Not affiliated with LinkedIn or Microsoft. LinkedIn is a trademark of LinkedIn Corporation.

Connect Claude to your LinkedIn account with an MCP Bundle (MCPB, formerly DXT). The bundle starts quickly, downloads the Patchright Chromium browser in the background when needed, and opens LinkedIn login on the first auth-requiring tool call.

## First-time managed runtime flow

1. Install the `.mcpb` bundle in Claude Desktop.
2. Start Claude Desktop; the MCP server starts and begins preparing the Patchright Chromium browser cache under `~/.linkedin-mcp/patchright-browsers`.
3. If you call a tool before setup finishes, the tool returns a setup-in-progress error.
4. On the first tool call that needs authentication, a browser window opens so you can sign into LinkedIn.
5. Retry the tool after login completes.

Docker remains available as a separate runtime path. There, a tool without a session asks to call `open_login`, which shows the LinkedIn sign-in inside the chat; `--login --login-viewer` and host-side `--login` remain the fallback.

tools.name: get_person_profile
tools.description: Get detailed information from a LinkedIn profile including work history, education, certifications, skills, projects, volunteering, connections, and recent posts

tools.name: get_my_profile
tools.description: Get the authenticated user's own LinkedIn profile with optional section selection (experience, education, skills, etc.)

tools.name: connect_with_person
tools.description: Send a connection request or accept an incoming one, with optional note

tools.name: get_sidebar_profiles
tools.description: Extract profile URLs from LinkedIn sidebar recommendation sections on a profile page

tools.name: get_company_profile
tools.description: Extract comprehensive company information and details. About-section references may include a company_urn entry carrying the numeric id LinkedIn's people-search uses in its currentCompany URL facet.

tools.name: get_company_posts
tools.description: Get recent posts from a company's LinkedIn feed

tools.name: search_companies
tools.description: Search for companies on LinkedIn by keywords

tools.name: get_company_employees
tools.description: List employees at a company from the LinkedIn /people/ page, with optional keyword filter by name, title, or skill

tools.name: get_job_details
tools.description: Retrieve specific job posting details using LinkedIn job IDs

tools.name: get_job_apply_url
tools.description: Read how a job posting takes applications and its employer application link

tools.name: get_easy_apply_form
tools.description: Read the questions of a job posting's Easy Apply form without typing, submitting or keeping a draft

tools.name: search_jobs
tools.description: Search for jobs with filters like keywords and location

tools.name: get_saved_jobs
tools.description: List job postings saved by the authenticated LinkedIn user

tools.name: save_job
tools.description: Save a LinkedIn job posting to your saved jobs

tools.name: unsave_job
tools.description: Remove a LinkedIn job posting from your saved jobs

tools.name: dismiss_job
tools.description: Dismiss a job from job search so later searches no longer show it

tools.name: get_post_details
tools.description: Read one LinkedIn post in full, with the comments its page shows

tools.name: like_post
tools.description: Like a LinkedIn post as the signed-in member; a post already liked is left alone

tools.name: unlike_post
tools.description: Remove the signed-in member's like or other reaction from a LinkedIn post; a post with none is left alone

tools.name: get_saved_posts
tools.description: List the posts and articles you saved

tools.name: get_my_groups
tools.description: List the groups you belong to, with links to read each one

tools.name: get_followers
tools.description: List the people who follow you

tools.name: get_following
tools.description: List the people and pages you follow

tools.name: get_followed_pages
tools.description: List the company, school and showcase pages you follow

tools.name: get_my_events
tools.description: List the events you are attending or organizing

tools.name: get_my_newsletters
tools.description: List the newsletters you subscribe to

tools.name: get_catch_up
tools.description: Read your network's job changes, work anniversaries and birthdays

tools.name: get_suggested_people
tools.description: List the people LinkedIn suggests you may know

tools.name: get_my_dashboard
tools.description: Read your dashboard: post impressions, followers and profile views

tools.name: get_search_appearances
tools.description: Read how often you appeared in search, and who searched

tools.name: get_content_analytics
tools.description: Read the impressions and engagement of your posts

tools.name: get_group_details
tools.description: Read a group's description and recent posts by its group ID

tools.name: get_event_details
tools.description: Read an event's time, place, organizer and details

tools.name: get_school_profile
tools.description: Read a school's or university's page

tools.name: get_school_alumni
tools.description: Read where a school's alumni live and work, and who they are

tools.name: get_article
tools.description: Read a LinkedIn article (a /pulse/ page) in full

tools.name: get_newsletter
tools.description: Read a newsletter's description and its editions

tools.name: search_groups
tools.description: Find groups by keyword, with group IDs for reading details

tools.name: search_events
tools.description: Find events by keyword, with links for reading details

tools.name: search_schools
tools.description: Find schools and universities by keyword

tools.name: get_invitations
tools.description: List your pending connection invitations, received or sent

tools.name: follow_company
tools.description: Follow a company page on LinkedIn

tools.name: unfollow_company
tools.description: Stop following a company page on LinkedIn

tools.name: follow_person
tools.description: Follow a person on LinkedIn without sending a connection invitation

tools.name: unfollow_person
tools.description: Stop following a person on LinkedIn

tools.name: react_to_post
tools.description: React to a LinkedIn post with like, celebrate, support, love, insightful or funny

tools.name: ignore_invitation
tools.description: Ignore the pending connection invitation one person sent you

tools.name: get_connections
tools.description: List your first-degree LinkedIn connections, most recently added first

tools.name: get_notifications
tools.description: Read your LinkedIn notifications, newest first

tools.name: get_profile_views
tools.description: Read who viewed your LinkedIn profile recently

tools.name: search_people
tools.description: Search for people on LinkedIn by keywords, location, connection degree (1st/2nd/3rd), current company, and mutual connections

tools.name: get_inbox
tools.description: List recent conversations from the LinkedIn messaging inbox

tools.name: get_conversation
tools.description: Read a specific messaging conversation by thread ID or LinkedIn username

tools.name: search_conversations
tools.description: Search LinkedIn messages by keyword

tools.name: archive_conversation
tools.description: Archive a LinkedIn messaging thread by thread ID, confirmed on a reload and never unarchived by a repeat call

tools.name: send_message
tools.description: Compose and send a new message, line breaks and empty lines included, without tab or other control characters to a LinkedIn user with explicit confirmation and optional profile URN support; profile-based targeting may create a separate DM instead of replying in an existing thread (use reply_to_conversation for that), and when no normal Message action is exposed, use connect_with_person and retry after acceptance

tools.name: reply_to_conversation
tools.description: Reply inside an existing messaging thread by thread ID, InMail included, with explicit confirmation; verifies the thread and its composer first and never clicks quick-reply buttons

tools.name: get_feed
tools.description: Get recent posts from the authenticated user's LinkedIn home feed

tools.name: search_posts
tools.description: Search LinkedIn posts/content globally by keyword (the 'Posts' tab) with an optional recency filter (past-24h/past-week/past-month) and content-type filter (e.g. documents); returns unordered candidate permalinks in references

tools.name: get_session_status
tools.description: Diagnose saved-session files and the serving process's browser state without opening a browser or contacting LinkedIn

tools.name: close_session
tools.description: Properly close browser session and clean up resources

chrome_path.title: Chrome executable
chrome_path.description: Optional. Path to a Chrome, Chromium or Chrome for Testing executable to use instead of the bundled Chromium, such as /usr/bin/google-chrome. Leave blank to use the bundled browser.

proxy_server.title: Proxy server
proxy_server.description: Optional. Route the browser through a proxy, as scheme://host:port (http, https, socks4 or socks5). May also include credentials, as http://user:password@host:port. Only browser traffic is routed.

proxy_username.title: Proxy username
proxy_username.description: Optional. Username for the proxy, if it requires one.

proxy_password.title: Proxy password
proxy_password.description: Optional. Password for the proxy. Chromium cannot authenticate to a SOCKS proxy, so credentials require an http or https endpoint.

proxy_bypass.title: Proxy bypass list
proxy_bypass.description: Optional. Comma-separated hosts to reach directly instead of through the proxy.
